	var inf := R * 1.6
	e.inf2 = inf * inf
	e.ov = R * (3.4 if style == S_PLASMA else 2.2)    # plasma: room for the droplet fan
	e.tess = R * 0.45
	e.treach = R * 1.3
	return e


# Pits over an area of radius R: n_pits of radius pr (a share of them torn through).
static func cluster(c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float, n_pits: int, pr: float, tear_share: float, seed_v: float, style := S_FLAK) -> Ent:
	var e := _base(K_CLUSTER, style, c, n, R, seed_v)
	var r := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	r.seed = int(seed_v * 1000.0) + 3
	var any_hole := false
	for i in n_pits:
		var an := r.randf() * TAU
		var rr := R * sqrt(r.randf())
		var s := pr * (0.6 + 0.8 * r.randf())
		if r.randf() < tear_share:
			s = -s * 0.7
			any_hole = true
		e.subs.append(Vector3(cos(an) * rr, sin(an) * rr, s))
	e.depth = pr * 0.5
	e.th = pr * 0.15
	e.D = pr * 1.2
	e.w = pr * 0.8
	e.cut = pr * 2.0
	var inf := R + pr * 2.5
	e.inf2 = inf * inf
	e.cutr2 = inf * inf if any_hole else 0.0
	e.ov = R * 1.35
	if any_hole:
		e.tess = pr * 1.2
		e.treach = R + pr * 2.0
	return e


static func surface(c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float, seed_v: float, style := S_ION) -> Ent:
	var e := _base(K_SURFACE, style, c, n, R, seed_v)
	e.inf2 = R * R
	e.ov = R
	return e


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the displacement fields (pure functions of position)

static func _nz(q: Vector3) -> float:
	return sin(q.x + 1.7 * sin(q.y * 0.8 + 0.3)) * sin(q.y * 1.13 + 1.3 * sin(q.z * 0.9 + 1.1)) * sin(q.z * 0.97 + 1.5 * sin(q.x * 0.7 + 2.3))


# Plates peeling back round holes: a point s from the hinge (the outer edge of the torn ring) turns about the hinge by an
# angle that grows toward the tip, so the plates curl (outward, or inward for a blast).
static func peel_at(P: Vector3, ents: Array) -> Vector3:
	var out := Vector3.ZERO
	for x in ents:
		var E: Ent = x
		if E.kind != K_HOLE or absf(E.bend) < 0.05:
			continue
		var d := P - E.c
		if d.length_squared() > E.cutr2:
			continue
		var h := d.dot(E.n)
		if h < -E.R * 0.45 or h > E.R * 0.8:
			continue
		var lx := d.dot(E.t1)
		var ly := d.dot(E.t2)
		var r := sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly)
		if r < 1e-6:
			continue
		var e := E.edge(lx, ly)
		if e >= E.w:
			continue
		var a := atan2(ly, lx)
		var s := clampf(E.w - e, 0.0, E.w * 1.25)
		var ang := E.bend * E.petal(a) * (s / E.w)
		var rad := (E.t1 * lx + E.t2 * ly) / r
		out += E.n * (s * sin(ang)) + rad * (s * (1.0 - cos(ang)))
	return out


static func buckle_at(P: Vector3, ents: Array) -> Vector3:
	var out := Vector3.ZERO
	for x in ents:
		var E: Ent = x
		if E.kind == K_SURFACE:
			continue
		var d := P - E.c
		if d.length_squared() > E.inf2:
			continue
		var h := d.dot(E.n)
		if E.style != S_RAM and (h < -E.R * 0.6 - E.depth or h > E.R * 0.6 + E.depth):
			continue
		var lx := d.dot(E.t1)
		var ly := d.dot(E.t2)
		var r := sqrt(lx * lx + ly * ly)
		var nzv := _nz(P * (4.0 / E.R) + Vector3(E.p[6], E.p[7], E.p[0]))
		match E.kind:
			K_DENT:
				if E.style == S_RAM:
					# r8: the bow crumples like a concertina. The falloff is by the full distance (a pointed bow runs back
					# along the hit normal, so the flat-dent band cut it off in a step); rings of folds run round the nose,
					# in and out from its axis; the tip is shoved back and kinked to one side. (r7: only a uniform push
					# back along the bow, which left the nose smooth and merely shorter.)
					var u3 := d.length() / E.R
					if u3 >= 1.0:
						continue
					var f3 := 1.0 - u3 * u3
					var rad := d - E.n * h
					var rl := rad.length()
					if rl > 1e-5:
						out += (rad / rl) * E.depth * 0.8 * sin(h / E.R * 9.0 + nzv * 2.2) * f3 * minf(rl / (E.R * 0.12), 1.0)
					out -= E.n * E.depth * f3 * f3 * (0.9 + 0.3 * nzv)
					out += E.t1 * E.depth * 0.9 * f3 * f3 * f3 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(E.p[3]))
					out -= E.n * E.depth * 0.2 * sin(lx / E.R * 11.0 + nzv * 1.5) * f3
					continue
				var u := r / E.R
				if u >= 1.0:
					continue
				var f := 1.0 - u * u
				var amp := E.depth * (f * f * (0.65 + 0.35 * nzv) + 0.22 * sin(u * 13.0 + nzv * 3.0) * (1.0 - u))
				out -= E.n * amp
			K_HOLE:
				var e := maxf(E.edge(lx, ly), 0.0)
				var u := e / (E.R * 1.4)
				if u >= 1.0:
					continue
				var amp := E.buckle * E.R * (1.0 - u) * (1.0 - u) * (0.6 + 0.4 * nzv) * (0.3 + 0.7 * smoothstep(0.0, E.w, e))
				amp += E.buckle * E.R * 0.2 * sin(u * 11.0 + nzv * 2.5) * (1.0 - u)
				out -= E.n * amp
			K_SLOT:
				# molten lips: the metal either side of the cut runs up into a ridge, then sags
				var e := E.edge(lx, ly)
				if e < 0.0:
					e = 0.0
				var u := e / E.w
				if u >= 2.5:
					continue
				var lip := E.R * 0.45 * exp(-u * u * 3.0) * (0.75 + 0.25 * nzv)
				if E.edge(lx, ly) < 0.0:
					lip = -E.R * 0.22 # solid molten floor below the raised lips
				var sag := E.R * 0.12 * smoothstep(0.4, 1.2, u) * (1.0 - smoothstep(1.2, 2.5, u))
				out += E.n * (lip - sag)
			K_CRATER:
				var u := r / E.R
				if u >= 1.6:
					continue
				var bowl := 0.0
				if u < 1.0:
					var f := 1.0 - u * u
					bowl = E.depth * f * f * (0.8 + 0.2 * nzv)
					if E.wound_kind == 2:
						bowl = floorf(bowl / maxf(E.depth, 0.001) * 4.0) * E.depth * 0.25
				var rim := E.depth * 0.42 * exp(-pow((u - 1.0) / 0.2, 2.0)) * (0.7 + 0.5 * maxf(nzv, 0.0))
				var splash := E.depth * 0.15 * sin(atan2(ly, lx) * 7.0 + E.p[3]) * exp(-pow((u - 1.15) / 0.3, 2.0))
				out -= E.n * (bowl - rim - splash)
			K_CLUSTER:
				for s in E.subs:
					var ex := lx - s.x
					var ey := ly - s.y
					var pr := absf(s.z)
					var u := sqrt(ex * ex + ey * ey) / (pr * 1.6)
					if u >= 1.0:
						continue
					var f := 1.0 - u * u
					var amp := E.depth * f * f * (pr / maxf(E.depth * 2.0, 1e-4))
					if E.style == S_ACID:
						# corroded: bubbled, blistered metal round the pits
						amp -= pr * 0.18 * (0.5 + 0.5 * nzv) * f
					out -= E.n * amp
	return out


# Which entry removes the triangle whose centre is Q (-1: none).
static func removed_by(Q: Vector3, ents: Array) -> int:
	for i in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[i]
		if not E.has_cut():
			continue
		var d := Q - E.c
		if d.length_squared() > E.cutr2:
			continue
		var h := d.dot(E.n)
		if h < -E.cut or h > E.R * 0.8 + E.depth:
			continue
		var lx := d.dot(E.t1)
		var ly := d.dot(E.t2)
		var e := E.edge(lx, ly)
		if e < 0.0:
			return i
		if E.kind == K_HOLE and E.bend > 0.3:
			var tw := E.w * 0.85
			if e < tw and E.tear(atan2(ly, lx)) < 0.1 * (1.0 - e / tw) + 0.01:
				return i
	return -1


# The cut entry whose torn ring holds P (-1: none).
static func owner_of(P: Vector3, ents: Array) -> int:
	var best := -1
	var bv := 1e9
	for i in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[i]
		if not E.has_cut():
			continue
		var d := P - E.c
		if d.length_squared() > E.cutr2:
			continue
		var v := E.edge(d.dot(E.t1), d.dot(E.t2)) / maxf(E.w, 1e-4)
		if v < bv:
			bv = v
			best = i
	return best


# The cavity floor under skin point P of entry E: pushed in deepest inside the outline, meeting the skin at the ring.
static func cup_at(P: Vector3, E: Ent, ents: Array) -> Vector3:
	var d := P - E.c
	var e := E.edge(d.dot(E.t1), d.dot(E.t2))
	var deep := smoothstep(E.w * 0.9, -minf(E.R, E.w) * 0.45, e)
	var depth := E.recess_depth()
	var rubble := depth * 0.14 * _nz(P * (6.0 / maxf(E.R, 1e-3)) + Vector3(E.p[1], E.p[2], E.p[3])) * deep
	return P + buckle_at(P, ents) - E.n * (E.th + depth * deep + rubble)


# Does the triangle centred at Q lie under E's overlay skin?
static func _in_overlay(Q: Vector3, E: Ent) -> bool:
	if E.ov <= 0.0:
		return false
	var d := Q - E.c
	var h := d.dot(E.n)
	if absf(h) > E.ov * 0.6 + E.depth:
		return false
	var lx := d.dot(E.t1)
	var ly := d.dot(E.t2)
	if E.kind == K_SLOT:
		var al := clampf(lx * E.dx + ly * E.dy, -E.hl, E.hl)
		var qx := lx - E.dx * al
		var qy := ly - E.dy * al
		return qx * qx + qy * qy < E.ov * E.ov
	return lx * lx + ly * ly < E.ov * E.ov


# Does triangle abc (centroid Q) reach into E's overlay? The centroid alone missed big plates under a small mark (r4).
static func _tri_in_overlay(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, Q: Vector3, E: Ent) -> bool:
	if E.ov <= 0.0:
		return false
	if _in_overlay(Q, E) or _in_overlay(a, E) or _in_overlay(b, E) or _in_overlay(c, E):
		return true
	var reach := E.ov + E.hl
	var r2 := reach * reach
	if (a - E.c).length_squared() > r2 * 16.0 and (b - E.c).length_squared() > r2 * 16.0 and (c - E.c).length_squared() > r2 * 16.0:
		# a cheap reject unless the triangle is big enough to span the mark
		var ext := maxf((b - a).length(), maxf((c - b).length(), (a - c).length()))
		if ext < reach * 2.0:
			return false
	if _in_overlay(_closest_on_tri(E.c, a, b, c), E):
		return true
	if E.kind == K_SLOT:
		return _in_overlay(_closest_on_tri(E.c + E.dir * E.hl, a, b, c), E) or _in_overlay(_closest_on_tri(E.c - E.dir * E.hl, a, b, c), E)
	return false


# Closest point to p on triangle abc (Ericson, Real-Time Collision Detection 5.1.5).
static func _closest_on_tri(p: Vector3, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3) -> Vector3:
	var ab := b - a
	var ac := c - a
	var ap := p - a
	var d1 := ab.dot(ap)
	var d2 := ac.dot(ap)
	if d1 <= 0.0 and d2 <= 0.0:
		return a
	var bp := p - b
	var d3 := ab.dot(bp)
	var d4 := ac.dot(bp)
	if d3 >= 0.0 and d4 <= d3:
		return b
	var vc := d1 * d4 - d3 * d2
	if vc <= 0.0 and d1 >= 0.0 and d3 <= 0.0:
		return a + ab * (d1 / (d1 - d3))
	var cp := p - c
	var d5 := ab.dot(cp)
	var d6 := ac.dot(cp)
	if d6 >= 0.0 and d5 <= d6:
		return c
	var vb := d5 * d2 - d1 * d6
	if vb <= 0.0 and d2 >= 0.0 and d6 <= 0.0:
		return a + ac * (d2 / (d2 - d6))
	var va := d3 * d6 - d5 * d4
	if va <= 0.0 and (d4 - d3) >= 0.0 and (d5 - d6) >= 0.0:
		return b + (c - b) * ((d4 - d3) / ((d4 - d3) + (d5 - d6)))
	var den := 1.0 / maxf(va + vb + vc, 1e-30)
	return a + ab * (vb * den) + ac * (vc * den)


static func _seg_pt_d2(p: Vector3, a: Vector3, b: Vector3) -> float:
	var ab := b - a
	var t := clampf((p - a).dot(ab) / maxf(ab.length_squared(), 1e-20), 0.0, 1.0)
	return (a + ab * t - p).length_squared()


# Should the edge pa-pb be split? Long against a mark's tess and within its treach. A pure function of the two end
# positions (in either order), so the triangles on both sides of an edge always agree and no crack opens.
static func _want_split(pa: Vector3, pb: Vector3, ents: Array, tess_min: float, lmin2 := 0.0) -> bool:
	var l2 := pa.distance_squared_to(pb)
	if l2 <= lmin2:
		return false
	for x in ents:
		var E: Ent = x
		var tl := maxf(E.tess, tess_min)
		if E.tess <= 0.0 or l2 <= tl * tl:
			continue
		var r2 := E.treach * E.treach
		if E.kind == K_SLOT:
			for k in 7:
				var sp := E.c + E.dir * E.hl * (float(k) / 3.0 - 1.0)
				if _seg_pt_d2(sp, pa, pb) < r2:
					return true
		elif _seg_pt_d2(E.c, pa, pb) < r2:
			return true
	return false


const REFINE_MAX_TRIS := 20000
const REFINE_PASSES := 6


# Split the candidate triangles near marks until their edges are short enough (red-green templates on the edges that
# need it, so neighbours stay conforming). New vertices interpolate every attribute of the surface, so the vertex format
# and the materials stay as they were. Returns {} when nothing needed splitting.
static func _refine(arr: Array, P: PackedVector3Array, idx: PackedInt32Array, cand: PackedInt32Array, ents: Array, tess_min: float) -> Dictionary:
	var any := false
	for x in ents:
		if (x as Ent).tess > 0.0:
			any = true
			break
	if not any:
		return {}
	# the shortest edge any mark asks for: finer edges are rejected before looking at the marks (8K hulls are mostly fine)
	var lmin := 1e9
	for x in ents:
		var E: Ent = x
		if E.tess > 0.0:
			lmin = minf(lmin, maxf(E.tess, tess_min))
	var lmin2 := lmin * lmin
	var nv0 := P.size()
	# attributes to interpolate: [array index, comps, kind] (kind 0 vec3, 1 vec2, 2 color, 3 float comps, 4 copy bytes, 5 copy ints)
	var attrs: Array = []
	var A := arr.duplicate()
	for k in Mesh.ARRAY_MAX:
		if k == Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX or A[k] == null:
			continue
		var v = A[k]
		if v is PackedVector3Array and v.size() == nv0:
			attrs.append([k, 3, 0])
		elif v is PackedVector2Array and v.size() == nv0:
			attrs.append([k, 2, 1])
		elif v is PackedColorArray and v.size() == nv0:
			attrs.append([k, 4, 2])
		elif v is PackedFloat32Array and v.size() > 0 and v.size() % nv0 == 0:
			attrs.append([k, v.size() / nv0, 3])
		elif v is PackedByteArray and v.size() > 0 and v.size() % nv0 == 0:
			attrs.append([k, v.size() / nv0, 4])
		elif v is PackedInt32Array and v.size() > 0 and v.size() % nv0 == 0:
			attrs.append([k, v.size() / nv0, 5])
		else:
			return {}
		A[k] = v.duplicate()
	var P2 := P.duplicate()
	var I2 := idx.duplicate()
	var C2 := cand.duplicate()
	var mids := {}
	var queue: Array = []
	for t in cand:
		queue.append(t)
	var added := 0
	for pass_i in REFINE_PASSES:
		if queue.is_empty() or added > REFINE_MAX_TRIS:
			break
		var nxt: Array = []
		for t in queue:
			if added > REFINE_MAX_TRIS:
				break
			var i0 := I2[t * 3]
			var i1 := I2[t * 3 + 1]
			var i2 := I2[t * 3 + 2]
			if i0 == i1 or i1 == i2 or i0 == i2:
				continue
			var s01 := _want_split(P2[i0], P2[i1], ents, tess_min, lmin2)
			var s12 := _want_split(P2[i1], P2[i2], ents, tess_min, lmin2)
			var s20 := _want_split(P2[i2], P2[i0], ents, tess_min, lmin2)
			var ns := int(s01) + int(s12) + int(s20)
			if ns == 0:
				continue
			var tris: Array = []
			if ns == 3:
				var m01 := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, i0, i1)
				var m12 := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, i1, i2)
				var m20 := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, i2, i0)
				tris = [[i0, m01, m20], [m01, i1, m12], [m20, m12, i2], [m01, m12, m20]]
			else:
				# rotate so the split edges come first: (a, b, c) with ab split, and bc too when two are split
				var a := i0
				var b := i1
				var c := i2
				if ns == 1:
					if s12:
						a = i1; b = i2; c = i0
					elif s20:
						a = i2; b = i0; c = i1
					var m := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, a, b)
					tris = [[a, m, c], [m, b, c]]
				else:
					if not s01:
						a = i1; b = i2; c = i0
					elif not s12:
						a = i2; b = i0; c = i1
					var mab := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, a, b)
					var mbc := _mid(A, attrs, P2, mids, b, c)
					tris = [[mab, b, mbc], [a, mab, mbc], [a, mbc, c]]
			for j in tris.size():
				var tr: Array = tris[j]
				var slot_t: int = t
				if j > 0:
					slot_t = I2.size() / 3
					I2.append(0)
					I2.append(0)
					I2.append(0)
					C2.append(slot_t)
					added += 1
				I2[slot_t * 3] = tr[0]
				I2[slot_t * 3 + 1] = tr[1]
				I2[slot_t * 3 + 2] = tr[2]
				nxt.append(slot_t)
		queue = nxt
	if added == 0:
		return {}
	return {"arr": A, "P": P2, "idx": I2, "cand": C2}


# The midpoint vertex of edge ia-ib (shared by both triangles on a welded edge), every attribute interpolated.
static func _mid(A: Array, attrs: Array, P2: PackedVector3Array, mids: Dictionary, ia: int, ib: int) -> int:
	var key := Vector2i(mini(ia, ib), maxi(ia, ib))
	var got = mids.get(key)
	if got != null:
		return got
	var ni := P2.size()
	P2.append((P2[ia] + P2[ib]) * 0.5)
	for at in attrs:
		var k: int = at[0]
		var cmp: int = at[1]
		var kind: int = at[2]
		var v = A[k]
		match kind:
			0:
				var m: Vector3 = (v[ia] + v[ib]) * 0.5
				if k == Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL and m.length_squared() > 1e-12:
					m = m.normalized()
				v.append(m)
			1:
				v.append((v[ia] + v[ib]) * 0.5)
			2:
				v.append((v[ia] as Color).lerp(v[ib], 0.5))
			3:
				var vals := PackedFloat32Array()
				vals.resize(cmp)
				for q in cmp:
					vals[q] = (v[ia * cmp + q] + v[ib * cmp + q]) * 0.5
				if k == Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT and cmp == 4:
					var tv := Vector3(vals[0], vals[1], vals[2])
					if tv.length_squared() > 1e-12:
						tv = tv.normalized()
					vals[0] = tv.x
					vals[1] = tv.y
					vals[2] = tv.z
					vals[3] = v[ia * cmp + 3]
				v.append_array(vals)
			_:
				for q in cmp:
					v.append(v[ia * cmp + q])
		A[k] = v
	mids[key] = ni
	return ni


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the worker

class Part:
	var pos := PackedVector3Array()
	var nrm := PackedVector3Array()
	var col := PackedColorArray()
	var opos := PackedVector3Array()     # overlay skin
	var onrm := PackedVector3Array()
	var ocol := PackedColorArray()
	var cup_f := PackedVector3Array()
	var cup_o := PackedVector3Array()


static func _tri(pt: Part, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, na: Vector3, nb: Vector3, nc: Vector3, want: Vector3, col: Color) -> void:
	# Godot's front faces wind clockwise: the geometric cross product points away from the wanted normal
	if (b - a).cross(c - a).dot(want) > 0.0:
		var t := b
		b = c
		c = t
		var tn := nb
		nb = nc
		nc = tn
	pt.pos.append(a)
	pt.pos.append(b)
	pt.pos.append(c)
	pt.nrm.append(na)
	pt.nrm.append(nb)
	pt.nrm.append(nc)
	pt.col.append(col)
	pt.col.append(col)
	pt.col.append(col)


static func _otri(pt: Part, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, na: Vector3, nb: Vector3, nc: Vector3, want: Vector3, col: Color) -> void:
	if (b - a).cross(c - a).dot(want) > 0.0:
		var t := b
		b = c
		c = t
		var tn := nb
		nb = nc
		nc = tn
	pt.opos.append(a)
	pt.opos.append(b)
	pt.opos.append(c)
	pt.onrm.append(na)
	pt.onrm.append(nb)
	pt.onrm.append(nc)
	pt.ocol.append(col)
	pt.ocol.append(col)
	pt.ocol.append(col)


static func _quad(pt: Part, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, d: Vector3, nrm: Vector3, col: Color) -> void:
	_tri(pt, a, b, c, nrm, nrm, nrm, nrm, col)
	_tri(pt, a, c, d, nrm, nrm, nrm, nrm, col)


static func _qk(p: Vector3, q: float) -> Vector3i:
	return Vector3i(roundi(p.x / q), roundi(p.y / q), roundi(p.z / q))


static func _edge_key(a: Vector3, b: Vector3, q: float) -> Array:
	var ka := _qk(a, q)
	var kb := _qk(b, q)
	return [ka, kb] if ka < kb else [kb, ka]


# job: {surfs: [{arrays, xf, aabb}], ents, q (weld size), cell (grid cell), ovl (overlay lift)}. Returns {surfs: [new
# arrays or null], parts: [Part per entry], ms}.
static func compute(job: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var t_ms := Time.get_ticks_msec()
	var ents: Array = job["ents"]
	var q: float = job["q"]
	var parts: Array = []
	for e in ents:
		parts.append(Part.new())
	var out_s: Array = []
	var edges := {}
	for sd in job["surfs"]:
		if bool(sd.get("interior", false)):
			out_s.append(null)
			continue
		var aabb: AABB = sd["aabb"]
		var hit := false
		for x in ents:
			var E: Ent = x
			if aabb.grow(sqrt(E.inf2) + E.ov).has_point(E.c):
				hit = true
				break
		if not hit:
			out_s.append(null)
			continue
		out_s.append(_surface(sd, ents, parts, edges, q, float(job.get("cell", 1.0)), float(job.get("ovl", 0.02)), q * 8.0))
	var t_surf := Time.get_ticks_msec() - t_ms
	# the cut edge: the skin's thickness along every edge between a kept and a removed triangle
	for key in edges:
		var ed: Dictionary = edges[key]
		if int(ed.get("k", 0)) < 1 or int(ed.get("r", 0)) < 1:
			continue
		var E: Ent = ents[int(ed["own"])]
		var pt: Part = parts[int(ed["own"])]
		var a: Vector3 = ed["a"]
		var b: Vector3 = ed["b"]
		var na: Vector3 = ed["na"]
		var nb: Vector3 = ed["nb"]
		var a2 := a - na * E.th
		var b2 := b - nb * E.th
		var mid := (a + b) * 0.5
		var inw: Vector3 = mid - (ed["kc"] as Vector3)
		inw = (inw - na * inw.dot(na)).normalized()
		var col := Color(PART_LIP, 0.5 + 0.5 * _nz(mid * 9.0 / maxf(E.R, 1e-3)), 0, 1)
		_quad(pt, a, b, b2, a2, inw, col)
		_quad(pt, a, b, b2, a2, -inw, col)
	for i in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[i]
		var authored := bool(job.get("hull").get("authored")) if job.get("hull") is Object else false
		if E.walls and E.style != S_BREACH and not E.through and not job.get("organic", false) and not authored:
			_walls(parts[i], E)
		if E.kind == K_HOLE and not authored:
			_throat(parts[i], E, int(job.get("wound_kind", 0)))
		elif E.style == S_PATCH and not job.get("flat", false):
			_patch(parts[i], E, job.get("hull"))
	# conduits and spines (they read the hull's triangle mesh only), then every mesh, all here on the worker: the main
	# thread only swaps them in (r3 showed the 8K barge's rebuild costing a long frame when the meshes were built there)
	var t_edges := Time.get_ticks_msec() - t_ms
	var hull = job.get("hull")
	var ends_by: Array = []
	var r := RandomNumberGenerator.new()
	for i in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[i]
		r.seed = int(E.seed_v * 1000.0) + 5
		var ends: Array = []
		if E.kind == K_HOLE and E.style != S_BREACH and E.conduits and not job.get("organic", false):
			ends = conduits(hull, parts[i], E, ents, r)
		elif E.kind == K_CLUSTER and E.style == S_ACID:
			spines(hull, parts[i], E, E.dir, r)
		ends_by.append([ends, r.state])
	var t_parts := Time.get_ticks_msec() - t_ms
	var mesh_src := {}
	var surfs: Array = job["surfs"]
	var groups := {}
	for k in surfs.size():
		var key: int = int(surfs[k]["mid"])
		if not groups.has(key):
			groups[key] = []
		(groups[key] as Array).append(k)
	for key in groups:
		var ks: Array = groups[key]
		var any := false
		for k in ks:
			if out_s[k] != null:
				any = true
		if not any or int(surfs[ks[0]]["n"]) != ks.size():
			continue
		var src: Array = []
		for k in ks:
			var sd: Dictionary = surfs[k]
			src.append([out_s[k] if out_s[k] != null else sd["arrays"], int(sd["fmt"]) & Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_COMPRESS_ATTRIBUTES, sd["mat"]])
		mesh_src[key] = src
	var inside_a = _merged(ents, parts, false)
	var skin_a = _merged(ents, parts, true)
	var res := {"surfs": out_s, "parts": parts, "ends": ends_by, "mesh_src": mesh_src, "inside_a": inside_a, "skin_a": skin_a}
	# the meshes are made here on the worker when the renderer allows it (r3: on the main thread the 8K barge's rebuild
	# cost a long frame); a headless run makes them in apply instead (G2: the headless renderer cannot build meshes on a
	# worker thread, which errored bot runs)
	if bool(job.get("mesh_on_worker", true)):
		build_meshes(res)
	# where the time went (ms from the start): surfaces, cut edges and walls, conduits and spines, then the meshes
	res["ms"] = Time.get_ticks_msec() - t_ms
	res["phases"] = [t_surf, t_edges, t_parts]
	return res


# Turn a rebuild's arrays into meshes (once: on the worker, or in apply on the main thread).
static func build_meshes(res: Dictionary) -> void:
	if res.has("meshes"):
		return
	var meshes := {}
	var mesh_src: Dictionary = res.get("mesh_src", {})
	for key in mesh_src:
		var am := ArrayMesh.new()
		for e in mesh_src[key]:
			am.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, e[0], [], {}, int(e[1]))
			am.surface_set_material(am.get_surface_count() - 1, e[2])
		meshes[key] = am
	res["meshes"] = meshes
	res["inside"] = _mesh_of(res.get("inside_a"))
	res["skin"] = _mesh_of(res.get("skin_a"))


static func _mesh_of(arr) -> ArrayMesh:
	if arr == null:
		return null
	var am := ArrayMesh.new()
	am.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr, [], {}, custom_flags())
	return am


# One surface: displace the skin near the damage, mark removed triangles zero-area, collect cavities and overlay skins.
# Only triangles in grid cells near the damage are visited (the grid and the ship-frame positions are built once per
# surface and kept in sd), so an 8K hull costs about what a game hull does.
static func _surface(sd: Dictionary, ents: Array, parts: Array, edges: Dictionary, q: float, cell: float, ovl: float, tess_min := 0.0):
	var arr: Array = sd["arrays"]
	var xf: Transform3D = sd["xf"]
	var V: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
	var N := PackedVector3Array()
	if arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] != null:
		N = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL]
	var has_n := N.size() == V.size()
	var nv := V.size()
	if not sd.has("P"):
		sd["P"] = xf * V
	var P: PackedVector3Array = sd["P"]
	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
	if arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] != null:
		idx = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
	if idx.is_empty():
		if not sd.has("ident"):
			var ident := PackedInt32Array()
			ident.resize(nv)
			for i in nv:
				ident[i] = i
			sd["ident"] = ident
		idx = sd["ident"]
	var nt := idx.size() / 3
	if not sd.has("grid"):
		# every triangle goes into each cell its box overlaps (r4: a big kit plate's centroid can sit cells away from a
		# mark on it, so centroid bucketing missed it), up to 64 cells; past that, its centroid's cell
		var grid := {}
		var big := PackedInt32Array()
		for t in nt:
			var a0 := P[idx[t * 3]] / cell
			var a1 := P[idx[t * 3 + 1]] / cell
			var a2 := P[idx[t * 3 + 2]] / cell
			var lo := Vector3i(floori(minf(a0.x, minf(a1.x, a2.x))), floori(minf(a0.y, minf(a1.y, a2.y))), floori(minf(a0.z, minf(a1.z, a2.z))))
			var hi := Vector3i(floori(maxf(a0.x, maxf(a1.x, a2.x))), floori(maxf(a0.y, maxf(a1.y, a2.y))), floori(maxf(a0.z, maxf(a1.z, a2.z))))
			var span := (hi - lo) + Vector3i.ONE
			if span.x * span.y * span.z > 64:
				# r13: a plate this big goes on a list every mark checks (centroid bucketing left whole kit plates out of
				# the overlay inside a mark's halo: hard-edged gaps and stray glowing triangles on the PC frigate)
				big.append(t)
				continue
			for gx in range(lo.x, hi.x + 1):
				for gy in range(lo.y, hi.y + 1):
					for gz in range(lo.z, hi.z + 1):
						var key := Vector3i(gx, gy, gz)
						if not grid.has(key):
							grid[key] = []
						(grid[key] as Array).append(t)
		sd["grid"] = grid
		sd["big"] = big
	var grid: Dictionary = sd["grid"]
	var big_t: PackedInt32Array = sd.get("big", PackedInt32Array())
	var tmark := PackedByteArray()
	tmark.resize(nt)
	var cand := PackedInt32Array()
	# which marks reach each grid cell (r5: an 8K hull's damaged region holds tens of thousands of vertices, and testing
	# every one against all 20 or so marks cost seconds; each triangle now only meets the marks of its own cell)
	var cell_ents := {}
	for ei in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[ei]
		var rr := maxf(sqrt(E.inf2), E.ov + E.hl) + cell
		var lo := (E.c - Vector3.ONE * rr) / cell
		var hi := (E.c + Vector3.ONE * rr) / cell
		for cx in range(floori(lo.x), floori(hi.x) + 1):
			for cy in range(floori(lo.y), floori(hi.y) + 1):
				for cz in range(floori(lo.z), floori(hi.z) + 1):
					var key := Vector3i(cx, cy, cz)
					if not grid.has(key):
						continue
					if not cell_ents.has(key):
						cell_ents[key] = PackedInt32Array()
					var ce: PackedInt32Array = cell_ents[key]
					ce.append(ei)
					cell_ents[key] = ce
	# per triangle, the index of its cell's mark list (-2: all marks, for a triangle in several cells' reach)
	var lists: Array = [ents]
	var maps: Array = [PackedInt32Array(range(ents.size()))]
	var tl := PackedInt32Array()
	tl.resize(nt)
	for key in cell_ents:
		var ce: PackedInt32Array = cell_ents[key]
		var sub: Array = []
		for ei in ce:
			sub.append(ents[ei])
		var li := lists.size()
		lists.append(sub)
		maps.append(ce)
		for t in grid[key]:
			if tmark[t] == 0:
				tmark[t] = 1
				cand.append(t)
				tl[t] = li
			elif tl[t] != li:
				tl[t] = 0
	# the big plates meet every mark (the overlay and vertex tests reject the far ones cheaply)
	for t in big_t:
		if tmark[t] == 0:
			tmark[t] = 1
			cand.append(t)
		tl[t] = 0
	if cand.is_empty():
		return null
	# split the big triangles near cutting and denting marks first, so a hole smaller than a plate can still be cut
	var rf: Dictionary = _refine(arr, P, idx, cand, ents, tess_min)
	if not rf.is_empty():
		arr = rf["arr"]
		P = rf["P"]
		idx = rf["idx"]
		cand = rf["cand"]
		N = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] if has_n else N
		nv = P.size()
		nt = idx.size() / 3
		# the split triangles meet every mark (a split triangle came from a big one, near several)
		var old_nt := tl.size()
		tl.resize(nt)
		for t in range(old_nt, nt):
			tl[t] = 0
		for t in cand:
			if t < old_nt and tl[t] > 0:
				tl[t] = 0
	var nb: Basis = xf.basis.inverse().transposed()
	var back: Basis = xf.basis.transposed()
	var near := PackedByteArray()
	near.resize(nv)
	var seen := PackedByteArray()
	seen.resize(nv)
	var Dp := P.duplicate()
	var NR := PackedVector3Array()
	NR.resize(nv)
	var pm := PackedFloat32Array()
	pm.resize(nv)
	var N2 := N.duplicate()
	var changed := false
	for t in cand:
		var lents: Array = lists[tl[t]]
		for j in 3:
			var i := idx[t * 3 + j]
			if seen[i] == 1:
				continue
			seen[i] = 1
			var p := P[i]
			var lvl := 0
			var eps := 1e9
			for x in lents:
				var E: Ent = x
				# surface-only marks (ion burns, the stage scorch) never move the skin: they only need the overlay
				if E.kind == K_SURFACE:
					continue
				var d2 := (p - E.c).length_squared()
				if d2 < E.inf2:
					if lvl == 0:
						lvl = 1
					eps = minf(eps, (E.w if E.kind == K_CLUSTER else E.R) * 0.04)
					if E.has_cut() and d2 < E.cutr2:
						lvl = 2
			var nr := (nb * N[i]).normalized() if has_n else Vector3.UP
			NR[i] = nr
			if lvl == 0:
				continue
			near[i] = lvl
			var pv := peel_at(p, lents)
			var dv := pv + buckle_at(p, lents)
			pm[i] = pv.length()
			if dv.length_squared() < 1e-12:
				continue
			changed = true
			var dp := p + dv
			Dp[i] = dp
			var ta := nr.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(nr.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
			var tb := nr.cross(ta)
			var pa := p + ta * eps
			pa += peel_at(pa, lents) + buckle_at(pa, lents)
			var pb := p + tb * eps
			pb += peel_at(pb, lents) + buckle_at(pb, lents)
			var nn := (pa - dp).cross(pb - dp)
			if nn.length_squared() > 1e-20:
				nn = nn.normalized()
				NR[i] = nn
				if has_n:
					N2[i] = (back * nn).normalized()
	var nidx := idx.duplicate()
	var removed_any := false
	var tri_i := PackedInt32Array([0, 0, 0])
	for t in cand:
		var lents: Array = lists[tl[t]]
		var lmap: PackedInt32Array = maps[tl[t]]
		var i0 := idx[t * 3]
		var i1 := idx[t * 3 + 1]
		var i2 := idx[t * 3 + 2]
		var a := P[i0]
		var b := P[i1]
		var c := P[i2]
		var Q := (a + b + c) / 3.0
		var cz := near[i0] == 2 or near[i1] == 2 or near[i2] == 2
		var ri := removed_by(Q, lents) if cz else -1
		if ri >= 0:
			ri = lmap[ri]
		var n0 := NR[i0]
		var n1 := NR[i1]
		var n2 := NR[i2]
		if ri >= 0:
			removed_any = true
			# a removed triangle stays in the buffer as a zero-area one (no index rebuild)
			nidx[t * 3 + 1] = i0
			nidx[t * 3 + 2] = i0
			var E: Ent = ents[ri]
			for pr in [[a, b], [b, c], [c, a]]:
				var key := _edge_key(pr[0], pr[1], q)
				var ed: Dictionary = edges.get(key, {})
				ed["r"] = int(ed.get("r", 0)) + 1
				ed["own"] = ri
				edges[key] = ed
			if not E.through and not bool(sd.get("authored", false)):
				_cup_tri(parts[ri], E, lents, a, b, c, n0 + n1 + n2)
			continue
		# the overlay skin over each mark this triangle lies under, lifted a hair off the hull
		var DQ := (Dp[i0] + Dp[i1] + Dp[i2]) / 3.0
		var tr2 := maxf(Q.distance_squared_to(a), maxf(Q.distance_squared_to(b), Q.distance_squared_to(c)))
		var trr := sqrt(tr2)
		for lj in lents.size():
			var Em: Ent = lents[lj]
			if Em.ov <= 0.0:
				continue
			var reach := Em.ov + Em.hl + trr
			if Q.distance_squared_to(Em.c) > reach * reach:
				continue
			if _tri_in_overlay(a, b, c, Q, Em):
				_otri(parts[lmap[lj]], Dp[i0] + n0 * ovl, Dp[i1] + n1 * ovl, Dp[i2] + n2 * ovl, n0, n1, n2, n0 + n1 + n2, Color(float(Em.style) / 16.0, 0, 0, 1))
		if not cz:
			continue
		tri_i[0] = i0
		tri_i[1] = i1
		tri_i[2] = i2
		for e3 in 3:
			var ia := tri_i[e3]
			var ib := tri_i[(e3 + 1) % 3]
			var key := _edge_key(P[ia], P[ib], q)
			var ed: Dictionary = edges.get(key, {})
			ed["k"] = int(ed.get("k", 0)) + 1
			ed["a"] = Dp[ia]
			ed["b"] = Dp[ib]
			ed["na"] = NR[ia]
			ed["nb"] = NR[ib]
			ed["kc"] = DQ
			edges[key] = ed
		var ow := owner_of(Q, lents)
		if ow < 0:
			continue
		ow = lmap[ow]
		var Eo: Ent = ents[ow]
		var nsum := n0 + n1 + n2
		# the back of the skin round the cut (and of the peeled plates), a plate's thickness in
		var pt: Part = parts[ow]
		var shade := 0.35 + 0.3 * _nz(Q * 5.0 / maxf(Eo.R, 1e-3))
		_tri(pt, Dp[i0] - n0 * Eo.th, Dp[i1] - n1 * Eo.th, Dp[i2] - n2 * Eo.th, -n0, -n1, -n2, -nsum, Color(PART_SKIN, shade, 0, 1))
		if maxf(pm[i0], maxf(pm[i1], pm[i2])) > Eo.R * 0.01 and not Eo.through and not bool(sd.get("authored", false)):
			_cup_tri(pt, Eo, lents, a, b, c, nsum)
	if not changed and not removed_any:
		return null
	var na := arr.duplicate()
	na[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = xf.affine_inverse() * Dp
	if has_n:
		na[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = N2
	na[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = nidx
	return na


static func _cup_tri(pt: Part, E: Ent, ents: Array, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, c: Vector3, nsum: Vector3) -> void:
	var fa := cup_at(a, E, ents)
	var fb := cup_at(b, E, ents)
	var fc := cup_at(c, E, ents)
	var fn := (fb - fa).cross(fc - fa)
	if fn.length_squared() < 1e-20:
		return
	fn = fn.normalized()
	if fn.dot(nsum + E.n) < 0.0:
		fn = -fn
	var shade := 0.4 + 0.3 * _nz((a + b + c) * (3.0 / maxf(E.R, 1e-3)))
	_tri(pt, fa, fb, fc, fn, fn, fn, fn, Color(PART_CUP, shade, 0, 1))
	if E.walls:
		pt.cup_f.append(fa)
		pt.cup_f.append(fb)
		pt.cup_f.append(fc)
		pt.cup_o.append(a + buckle_at(a, ents))
		pt.cup_o.append(b + buckle_at(b, ents))
		pt.cup_o.append(c + buckle_at(c, ents))


# Frames (across the ship) and deck layers (level, when the hole faces sideways) sliced through a cavity: each slice of
# the floor stood up as a wall to just under the skin, with a ragged top, some blown away.
static func _throat(pt: Part, E: Ent, wound_kind := 0) -> void:
	var first_vertex := pt.pos.size()
	var depth := E.recess_depth()
	var centre := E.c - E.n * depth
	var count := 12 if wound_kind in [2, 3] else 32
	for i in count:
		var rings: Array = []
		for j in [i, (i + 1) % count]:
			var angle := float(j) * TAU / count
			var radial := E.t1 * cos(angle) + E.t2 * sin(angle)
			var rr := E.rh(angle)
			if wound_kind == 1: radial = E.t1 * cos(angle) * 1.15 + E.t2 * sin(angle) * 0.8
			rings.append(E.c + radial * rr * 1.04 - E.n * E.th * 0.2)
			rings.append(centre + radial * rr * 0.58)
		var a: Vector3 = rings[0]
		var b: Vector3 = rings[2]
		var c: Vector3 = rings[3]
		var d: Vector3 = rings[1]
		_quad(pt, a, b, c, d, (centre - (a + b) * 0.5).normalized(), Color(PART_CUP, 0.15, 0, 1))
		_tri(pt, centre - E.n * E.R * 0.15, d, c, E.n, E.n, E.n, E.n, Color(PART_CUP, 0.2, 0, 1))
		# Thick stepped collar, ending in curled tabs, diameter about 0.14 L.
		var reach := 2.15 if i % 4 < 2 else 1.25
		if wound_kind == 1: reach = 1.4
		var lipa := E.c + (a - E.c) * reach + E.n * E.R * 0.03
		var lipb := E.c + (b - E.c) * reach + E.n * E.R * 0.03
		var bend := E.n * E.R * (0.06 + E.petal(float(i) * TAU / count) * 0.18)
		_quad(pt, a, b, lipb + bend, lipa + bend, E.n, Color(PART_LIP, 0.6, 0, 1))
		_quad(pt, lipa, lipb, lipb + bend, lipa + bend, (lipa - E.c).normalized(), Color(PART_SKIN, 0.6, 0, 1))
	# Three actual cross members: 18 triangles, seated partway down the throat.
	for j in 3:
		var rib := E.c - E.n * depth * (0.3 + 0.16 * j) + E.t2 * E.R * (j - 1) * 0.38
		var a := rib - E.t1 * E.R * 0.9
		var b := rib + E.t1 * E.R * 0.9
		if wound_kind == 1:
			var pts := PackedVector3Array([a, rib + E.n * E.R * 0.3, b])
			_tube(pt, pts, E.R * 0.06, E.R * 0.035, Color(PART_BONE, 0.6, 0, 1))
		else:
			var side := E.t2 * E.R * 0.055
			var rise := E.n * E.R * 0.08
			_quad(pt, a - side, b - side, b + side, a + side, E.n, Color(PART_WALL, 0.7, 0, 1))
			_quad(pt, a - side, a + rise, b + rise, b - side, -E.t2, Color(PART_PIPE, 0.6, 0, 1))
			_quad(pt, a + rise, a + side, b + side, b + rise, E.t2, Color(PART_WALL, 0.6, 0, 1))
	if wound_kind == 1:
		_tissue(pt, E)
		for j in 3:
			var organ := E.c - E.n * depth * 0.6 + E.t1 * E.R * (j - 1) * 0.35
			_tube(pt, PackedVector3Array([organ - E.t2 * E.R * 0.12, organ + E.n * E.R * 0.06, organ + E.t2 * E.R * 0.12]), E.R * 0.14, E.R * 0.07, Color(PART_PIPE, 0.7, 0, 1))
	for i in range(first_vertex, pt.pos.size()):
		var behind := (E.c - pt.pos[i]).dot(E.n)
		if behind > E.cut: pt.pos[i] += E.n * (behind - E.cut)


static func _patch(pt: Part, E: Ent, hull) -> void:
	# Ray-fit replacement plate and weld ridge to the surviving real skin.
	var points := PackedVector3Array()
	for j in 9:
		var a := float(j % 8) * TAU / 8.0
		var p := E.c + (E.t1 * cos(a) + E.t2 * sin(a)) * E.R
		var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(p + E.n * E.R * 2.0, -E.n) if hull != null else {}
		# A raised plate needs supporting skin across its whole outline. On a
		# narrow tower or a steep curve the conforming patch overlay seals it.
		if h.is_empty() or absf(((h.p as Vector3) - p).dot(E.n)) > E.R * 0.22:
			return
		points.append((h.get("p", p) as Vector3) + E.n * E.R * 0.045)
	for j in 8:
		_tri(pt, E.c + E.n * E.R * 0.045, points[j], points[j + 1], E.n, E.n, E.n, E.n, Color(PART_SKIN, 0.65, 0, 1))
	_tube(pt, points, E.R * 0.024, E.R * 0.024, Color(PART_LIP, 0.5, 0, 1))


static func _walls(pt: Part, E: Ent) -> void:
	var fam: Array = []
	var ax_a := Vector3.RIGHT if absf(E.n.x) < 0.75 else Vector3.BACK
	fam.append([ax_a, E.R * 0.5, E.p[4] / TAU * E.R * 0.5, 0.55])
	if absf(E.n.y) < 0.7:
		fam.append([Vector3.UP, E.R * 0.7, E.p[5] / TAU * E.R * 0.7, 0.75])
	var tw := E.R * 0.028
	var F := pt.cup_f
	var O := pt.cup_o
	var nt := F.size() / 3
	for f in fam:
		var ax: Vector3 = f[0]
		var spc: float = f[1]
		var off: float = f[2]
		var shade: float = f[3]
		var o := ax * (tw * 0.5)
		for t in nt:
			var d0 := F[t * 3].dot(ax)
			var d1 := F[t * 3 + 1].dot(ax)
			var d2 := F[t * 3 + 2].dot(ax)
			var k0 := ceili((minf(d0, minf(d1, d2)) - off) / spc)
			var k1 := floori((maxf(d0, maxf(d1, d2)) - off) / spc)
			for kk in range(k0, k1 + 1):
				var v := off + kk * spc
				var pf := PackedVector3Array()
				var po := PackedVector3Array()
				for e3 in 3:
					var ia := t * 3 + e3
					var ib := t * 3 + (e3 + 1) % 3
					var da := F[ia].dot(ax) - v
					var db := F[ib].dot(ax) - v
					if da * db < 0.0:
						var u := da / (da - db)
						pf.append(F[ia].lerp(F[ib], u))
						po.append(O[ia].lerp(O[ib], u))
				if pf.size() != 2:
					continue
				var dep := ((po[0] - pf[0]).length() + (po[1] - pf[1]).length()) * 0.5
				if dep < E.th * 2.2:
					continue
				var mid := (pf[0] + pf[1]) * 0.5
				if _nz(mid * (3.0 / E.R) + Vector3(E.p[2], kk, E.p[3])) > 0.3:
					continue
				var tf0 := 0.88 + 0.06 * _nz(pf[0] * (5.0 / E.R))
				var tf1 := 0.88 + 0.06 * _nz(pf[1] * (5.0 / E.R))
				var t0 := pf[0].lerp(po[0], tf0)
				var t1 := pf[1].lerp(po[1], tf1)
				var col := Color(PART_WALL, shade, 0, 1)
				_quad(pt, pf[0] + o, pf[1] + o, t1 + o, t0 + o, ax, col)
				_quad(pt, pf[0] - o, pf[1] - o, t1 - o, t0 - o, -ax, col)
				var up := ((po[0] - pf[0]) + (po[1] - pf[1])).normalized()
				_quad(pt, t0 + o, t1 + o, t1 - o, t0 - o, up, col)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- main thread: conduits, cables, spines, emitters

static func _tube(pt: Part, pts: PackedVector3Array, r0: float, r1: float, col: Color) -> void:
	var n := pts.size()
	if n < 2:
		return
	var sides := 6
	var prev_ring: Array = []
	for i in n:
		var tng := (pts[mini(i + 1, n - 1)] - pts[maxi(i - 1, 0)]).normalized()
		var s1 := tng.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(tng.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
		var s2 := tng.cross(s1)
		var rr := lerpf(r0, r1, float(i) / float(n - 1))
		var ring: Array = []
		for k in sides:
			var an := TAU * k / sides
			var dn := s1 * cos(an) + s2 * sin(an)
			ring.append([pts[i] + dn * rr, dn])
		if i > 0:
			for k in sides:
				var a: Array = prev_ring[k]
				var b: Array = prev_ring[(k + 1) % sides]
				var c: Array = ring[(k + 1) % sides]
				var d: Array = ring[k]
				var want: Vector3 = (a[1] as Vector3) + (c[1] as Vector3)
				_tri(pt, a[0], b[0], c[0], a[1], b[1], c[1], want, col)
				_tri(pt, a[0], c[0], d[0], a[1], c[1], d[1], want, col)
		prev_ring = ring


# Conduits running fore and aft across a cavity (some torn apart) and cables trailing out of the hole. Returns the torn
# ends and cable tips, where the sparks go: [[pos, dir], ...].
static func conduits(hull, pt: Part, E: Ent, ents: Array, r: RandomNumberGenerator) -> Array:
	var ends: Array = []
	if E.through or hull == null or not E.conduits:
		return ends
	var u := (Vector3.RIGHT - E.n * E.n.x)
	if u.length_squared() < 0.05:
		u = E.t1
	u = u.normalized()
	var v := E.n.cross(u)
	var npipe := 2 + (1 if E.R > 1.2 else 0)
	for j in npipe:
		var off := (r.randf() - 0.5) * E.R * 1.1
		var lf := 0.3 + r.randf() * 0.4
		var pr := E.R * (0.03 + r.randf() * 0.03)
		var broken := r.randf() < 0.75
		var gc := (r.randf() - 0.5) * E.R * 0.8
		var gw := E.R * (0.12 + r.randf() * 0.25) if broken else 0.0
		var pts: Array = []      # per sample: a point, or 0 (torn gap), or 1 (no hull under it)
		var s := -E.R * 1.4
		var col := Color(PART_PIPE, 0.3 + 0.5 * r.randf(), 0, 1)
		while s <= E.R * 1.4 + 1e-4:
			if absf(s - gc) < gw:
				pts.append(0)
			else:
				var Q := E.c + u * s + v * off
				var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(Q + E.n * E.R * 1.5, -E.n)
				if h.is_empty():
					pts.append(1)
				else:
					var Os: Vector3 = h["p"]
					var dd := Os - E.c
					if E.edge(dd.dot(E.t1), dd.dot(E.t2)) > E.w * 0.9:
						pts.append(Os + buckle_at(Os, ents) - E.n * (E.th + pr * 1.3))
					else:
						var Fp := cup_at(Os, E, ents)
						var dep := (Os - Fp).dot(E.n)
						pts.append(Fp + E.n * clampf(dep * lf, pr * 1.2, maxf(dep - E.th - pr, pr * 1.2)))
			s += E.R * 0.15
		var k0 := 0
		while k0 < pts.size():
			if not (pts[k0] is Vector3):
				k0 += 1
				continue
			var k1 := k0
			var seg := PackedVector3Array()
			while k1 < pts.size() and pts[k1] is Vector3:
				seg.append(pts[k1])
				k1 += 1
			if seg.size() >= 2:
				_tube(pt, seg, pr, pr, col)
				if k0 > 0 and pts[k0 - 1] is int and int(pts[k0 - 1]) == 0:
					ends.append([seg[0], -u])
				if k1 < pts.size() and pts[k1] is int and int(pts[k1]) == 0:
					ends.append([seg[seg.size() - 1], u])
			k0 = k1
	var ncab := 1 + (1 if E.bend > 1.0 else 0)
	for j in ncab:
		var an := r.randf() * TAU
		var rr := E.R * (0.25 + r.randf() * 0.35)
		var Q := E.c + (E.t1 * cos(an) + E.t2 * sin(an)) * rr
		var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(Q + E.n * E.R * 1.5, -E.n)
		if h.is_empty():
			continue
		var Fp := cup_at(h["p"], E, ents)
		var dep := ((h["p"] as Vector3) - Fp).dot(E.n)
		var st := Fp + E.n * dep * 0.25
		var rd := (E.t1 * cos(an) + E.t2 * sin(an))
		var side := E.n.cross(rd)
		var Lc := E.R * (0.45 + r.randf() * 0.35) + dep
		var ph := r.randf() * TAU
		var cp := PackedVector3Array()
		for k in 8:
			var tt := k / 7.0
			cp.append(st + E.n * (tt * Lc * 0.75) + rd * (tt * tt * Lc * 0.6) + side * (sin(tt * 4.0 + ph) * Lc * 0.08))
		_tube(pt, cp, E.R * 0.024, E.R * 0.018, Color(PART_PIPE, 0.15, 0, 1))
		ends.append([cp[7], (cp[7] - cp[6]).normalized()])
	return ends


# Chorus spine shafts stuck in the hull at a cluster's pits, leaning back the way they came.
static func spines(hull, pt: Part, E: Ent, back_dir: Vector3, r: RandomNumberGenerator) -> void:
	if hull == null:
		return
	var nsp := 0
	for s in E.subs:
		if nsp >= 4 or r.randf() < 0.4:
			continue
		var Q := E.c + E.t1 * s.x + E.t2 * s.y
		var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(Q + E.n * E.R, -E.n)
		if h.is_empty():
			continue
		var base: Vector3 = (h["p"] as Vector3) - E.n * absf(s.z) * 0.8
		var d := (back_dir.normalized() * 0.7 + E.n * 0.5 + Vector3(r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5) * 0.3).normalized()
		var ln := E.R * (0.5 + r.randf() * 0.5)
		var sp := PackedVector3Array()
		for k in 5:
			sp.append(base + d * ln * (k / 4.0) + E.n.cross(d) * sin(k * 0.9) * ln * 0.03)
		_tube(pt, sp, absf(s.z) * 0.55, absf(s.z) * 0.08, Color(PART_BONE, 0.4 + 0.4 * r.randf(), 0, 1))
		nsp += 1


# Fire, embers, thin smoke, venting gas and sparks for a breach or blast hole, all from inside it (repeating on the
# effect clock, so a rebuild does not restart them).
static func emitters(b: POOLS.Batch, bs: POOLS.Batch, E: Ent, ents: Array, ends: Array, r: RandomNumberGenerator, glow: Color) -> void:
	var q := POOLS.quad_shape()
	var qs := POOLS.streak_shape()
	var R := E.R
	var hot := absf(E.bend) > 1.0 or E.style == S_BLAST
	var floor_pts: Array = []
	for j in (3 if hot else 2):
		var an := r.randf() * TAU
		var p := E.c + (E.t1 * cos(an) + E.t2 * sin(an)) * R * r.randf() * 0.45
		floor_pts.append(p - E.n * minf(maxf(E.recess_depth() * 0.65, R * 0.18), E.cut * 0.85))
	for fp in floor_pts:
		var P: Vector3 = fp
		for kk in 3:
			var v := E.n * R * (1.3 + r.randf() * 0.9) + E.t1 * (r.randf() - 0.5) * R * 0.5 + E.t2 * (r.randf() - 0.5) * R * 0.5
			b.add(q, POOLS.pack(Vector4(P.x, P.y, P.z, -20.0 + kk * 0.09), Vector4(v.x, v.y, v.z, 0.55 + r.randf() * 0.3),
				Vector4(0.65, 0.16, 0.025, 0.45), Vector4(R * 0.06, R * 0.15, 1, r.randf()), Vector4(0.8, 0, 0, 0)))
	var P0: Vector3 = floor_pts[0]
	for kk in (3 if hot else 2):
		var v := (E.n * 1.0 + Vector3(r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5) * 0.9).normalized() * R * (0.5 + r.randf() * 0.9)
		b.add(q, POOLS.pack(Vector4(P0.x, P0.y, P0.z, -20.0 + kk * 0.37 + r.randf() * 0.2), Vector4(v.x, v.y, v.z, 3.2),
			Vector4(glow.r, glow.g, glow.b, 2.0), Vector4(R * 0.025, R * 0.015, 16, r.randf()), Vector4(3.9, 0, 0.3, 0)))
	for kk in 3:
		var v := E.n * R * 1.4 + Vector3(0, R * 0.2, 0)
		b.add(q, POOLS.pack(Vector4(P0.x, P0.y, P0.z, -20.0 + kk * 0.9 + r.randf() * 0.2), Vector4(v.x, v.y, v.z, 2.7),
			Vector4(0.1, 0.095, 0.09, 0.2), Vector4(R * 0.35, R * 1.7, 3, r.randf()), Vector4(2.7, 0, 0.7, 0.3)))
	var vp: Vector3 = P0
	var vd: Vector3 = E.n
	if not ends.is_empty():
		vp = ends[0][0]
		vd = ((ends[0][1] as Vector3) * 0.5 + E.n).normalized()
	for kk in 16:
		var tk := -20.0 + kk * 0.08
		var puff := 0.7 + 0.3 * sin(kk * 0.9)
		var v := (vd + E.t1 * sin(kk * 0.45) * 0.15).normalized() * R * (3.2 + r.randf()) * puff
		b.add(q, POOLS.pack(Vector4(vp.x, vp.y, vp.z, tk), Vector4(v.x, v.y, v.z, 1.1), Vector4(0.62, 0.68, 0.78, 0.22 * puff),
			Vector4(R * 0.07, R * 0.7, 7, r.randf()), Vector4(1.3, 0, 0.8, r.randf() - 0.5)))
	for e2 in ends:
		var sp: Vector3 = e2[0]
		var sd: Vector3 = e2[1]
		var per := 0.9 + r.randf() * 1.6
		var off := r.randf() * per
		for kk in 7:
			var v := (sd + E.n * 0.4 + Vector3(r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5, r.randf() - 0.5) * 0.9).normalized() * R * (2.5 + r.randf() * 4.0)
			bs.add(qs, POOLS.pack(Vector4(sp.x, sp.y, sp.z, off + r.randf() * 0.06), Vector4(v.x, v.y, v.z, 0.25 + r.randf() * 0.3),
				Vector4(1.0, 0.75, 0.45, 3.5), Vector4(0.035, R * 0.025, 2.2, 1), Vector4(per, 0, 0, 0)))
		b.add(q, POOLS.pack(Vector4(sp.x, sp.y, sp.z, off), Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0.12), Vector4(1.0, 0.8, 0.55, 2.5),
			Vector4(R * 0.05, R * 0.12, 2, r.randf()), Vector4(per, 0, 0, 0)))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- ship side: gather, rebuild, apply

static func is_turret_mesh(s, mi: Node) -> bool:
	var hull = s.hull
	if hull == null or not ("_turret_of" in hull):
		return false
	if (hull._turret_of as Dictionary).has(mi.get_instance_id()):
		return true
	return hull._turret_above(mi, s.root) >= 0


static func gather(s) -> Array:
	var out: Array = []
	# (F3: a ship whose node was freed before its first rebuild came round has nothing to gather)
	if not is_instance_valid(s.root) or not s.root.is_inside_tree():
		return out
	# in the hull's pose when the ship was added (the frame of its analysis and of the damage root, which follows it)
	var inv: Transform3D = s.hull_motion().affine_inverse() * s.root.global_transform.affine_inverse()
	for m in s.meshes:
		if not is_instance_valid(m):
			continue
		var mi := m as MeshInstance3D
		if mi == null or not (mi.mesh is ArrayMesh) or not mi.is_inside_tree():
			continue
		# issue 1235 (F3.4): never a turret's turning mesh; a scar baked in its pose of the moment hung in the air
		# once the turret trained back (fx_ship picks its damage reference mesh the same way)
		if is_turret_mesh(s, mi):
			continue
		var am: ArrayMesh = mi.mesh
		if am.get_blend_shape_count() > 0:
			continue
		var xf: Transform3D = inv * mi.global_transform
		var aabb: AABB = xf * am.get_aabb()
		for si in am.get_surface_count():
			if am.surface_get_primitive_type(si) != Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES:
				continue
			out.append({"mi": mi, "mid": mi.get_instance_id(), "si": si, "arrays": s.arrays_of(am, si), "xf": xf, "aabb": aabb,
				"fmt": am.surface_get_format(si), "mat": am.surface_get_material(si), "mesh": am,
				"ov": mi.get_surface_override_material(si), "global_ov": mi.material_override, "n": am.get_surface_count(),
				"authored": s.hull.authored, "interior": s.hull.authored and HULL.interior_material(am.surface_get_material(si)) and not am.surface_get_material(si).resource_name.ends_with("_inside_skin")})
	return out


# One mesh's arrays from every entry's parts (the interior, or the overlay skins), each vertex carrying its entry's data:
# CUSTOM0 (centre, R), CUSTOM1 (normal, opened at), CUSTOM2 (cavity depth, heat, seed, style), CUSTOM3 (slot dir, half length).
static func _merged(ents: Array, parts: Array, overlay: bool):
	var pos := PackedVector3Array()
	var nrm := PackedVector3Array()
	var col := PackedColorArray()
	var c0 := PackedFloat32Array()
	var c1 := PackedFloat32Array()
	var c2 := PackedFloat32Array()
	var c3 := PackedFloat32Array()
	for i in ents.size():
		var E: Ent = ents[i]
		var pt: Part = parts[i]
		var pp: PackedVector3Array = pt.opos if overlay else pt.pos
		if pp.is_empty():
			continue
		pos.append_array(pp)
		nrm.append_array(pt.onrm if overlay else pt.nrm)
		col.append_array(pt.ocol if overlay else pt.col)
		var cnt := pp.size()
		c0.append_array(_rep4(Vector4(E.c.x, E.c.y, E.c.z, E.R), cnt))
		c1.append_array(_rep4(Vector4(E.n.x, E.n.y, E.n.z, E.t0), cnt))
		# the overlay's CUSTOM2.x is the halo extent in units of R (the interior's is the cavity depth)
		var c2x: float = (E.halo / maxf(E.R, 1e-4)) if overlay else (E.recess_depth() if not E.through else E.R * 0.2)
		c2.append_array(_rep4(Vector4(c2x, E.heat, E.seed_v, float(E.style)), cnt))
		c3.append_array(_rep4(Vector4(E.dir.x, E.dir.y, E.dir.z, E.hl), cnt))
	if pos.size() < 3:
		return null
	var arr := []
	arr.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = pos
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = nrm
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = col
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM0] = c0
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM1] = c1
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM2] = c2
	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM3] = c3
	return arr


static func custom_flags() -> int:
	var f := Mesh.ARRAY_CUSTOM_RGBA_FLOAT
	return (f << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM0_SHIFT) | (f << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM1_SHIFT) | (f << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM2_SHIFT) | (f << Mesh.ARRAY_FORMAT_CUSTOM3_SHIFT)


static func _rep4(v: Vector4, n: int) -> PackedFloat32Array:
	var one := PackedFloat32Array([v.x, v.y, v.z, v.w])
	return POOLS.repeat_f(one, n)


static func apply(fx, s, job: Dictionary) -> void:
	var res: Dictionary = job.get("out", {})
	if res.is_empty():
		return
	# (F3: the ship's nodes were freed while its rebuild ran on the worker: nothing left to show it on)
	if not is_instance_valid(s.root) or not s.root.is_inside_tree() or not is_instance_valid(s._dmg_root):
		return
	var t_b := Time.get_ticks_usec()
	build_meshes(res)
	t_b = fx.pend("ba_build", t_b)
	var orig: Array = job["surfs"]
	var meshes: Dictionary = res.get("meshes", {})
	var by_mi := {}
	for k in orig.size():
		var sd: Dictionary = orig[k]
		# (F3: untyped first, so a hull freed while its rebuild ran is skipped instead of erroring on the typed assign)
		var mi0 = sd["mi"]
		if not is_instance_valid(mi0):
			continue
		var mi: MeshInstance3D = mi0
		if not by_mi.has(mi):
			by_mi[mi] = []
		(by_mi[mi] as Array).append(k)
	for mi in by_mi:
		var ks: Array = by_mi[mi]
		var sd0: Dictionary = orig[ks[0]]
		# the damage overlay copies the full-detail triangles: an imported hull drawn at a lower automatic LOD would cover
		# it (r6: ion burns and flak pocks, which leave the mesh itself unchanged, vanished on the 8K hulls), so a mesh

	vec3 hot = mix(vec3(1.0, 0.97, 0.92), vCol.rgb, 0.14);
	vec3 tint = vCol.rgb;
	float motion = 0.75 + 0.5 * fast;
	float fork_hot = 0.0; float fork_glow = 0.0;
	if (k == 0 || k == 3) {
		float turbulence = fbm(vec2(s * 9.0 - age * 8.0, vSide * 3.0 + seed));
		float shape = spow(1.0 - s, 1.25) * smoothstep(0.22, 0.65, turbulence + 0.2);
		core *= shape * (0.8 + 0.3 * sin(s * 29.0 - age * 9.0));
		sheath *= shape;
		if (k == 3) { motion *= mix(cough(scene_t - s * 0.2, seed), 0.8, fx_calm); }
		ends = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.72, 1.0, s);
	} else if (k == 1) {
		float fade = spow(1.0 - s, 1.5);
		core *= fade * 0.4;
		sheath *= fade * (0.4 + slow);
	} else if (k == 6) {
		// Keep the faction hue in the sheath without whitening it into the
		// trunk. Forks reach outside the trunk's bloom footprint.
		tint /= max(max(tint.r, tint.g), max(tint.b, 0.0001));
		tint = mix(tint, tint * tint * tint * tint, 0.8);
		float strike = floor(age / mix(0.07, 0.23, fx_calm));
		motion = flick(0.75 + 0.25 * h21(vec2(strike, seed)), age, seed);
		// Forks grow from the live jagged path. They occupy distinct filled
		// pixels inside the wider sheath, and never detach from the trunk.
		float q = fract(s * 4.0 + seed);
		float sign_side = mod(floor(s * 4.0 + seed), 2.0) * 2.0 - 1.0;
		float target = sign_side * q * 1.7;
		float d = (vSide - target) * vPixels * 0.5 / fr;
		float window = smoothstep(0.0, 0.04, q) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.32, 0.55, q));
		fork_hot = exp(-2.772589 * d*d / 4.0) * window;
		fork_glow = exp(-2.772589 * d*d / 25.0) * window;
	} else if (k == 5) {
		// Broken crawling filaments, replacing the regular diagonal bands.
		float arc = sin(s * 27.0 - age * 17.0 + seed) * 0.55;
		float d = (vSide - arc) * vPixels * 0.5;
		fork_hot = exp(-2.772589 * d*d / 4.0) * smoothstep(0.45, 0.7, fast);
	} else if (k == 7) {
		float pulse = spow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 30.0 - age * 25.0), 3.0);
		motion *= 0.35 + pulse;
		vec3 rainbow = clamp(abs(fract(x * 0.45 + s * 0.6 - age * 0.4 + seed + vec3(0.0, 0.333, 0.667)) * 6.0 - 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
		tint = mix(tint, rainbow, 0.65);
	} else if (k == 8) {
		motion *= 0.7 + 0.5 * spow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin(s * 63.0 - age * 28.0), 6.0);
		// A white needle with a thin, moving spectrum along either edge.
		vec3 rainbow = clamp(abs(fract(vSide * 0.30 + s * 0.45 - age * 0.35 + seed + vec3(0.0, 0.333, 0.667)) * 6.0 - 3.0) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0);
		tint = mix(tint, rainbow, smoothstep(1.1, 3.0, px) * 0.90);
	} else if (k == 9) {
		float tissue = fbm(vec2(s * 14.0 - age * 3.0, vSide * 2.0 + seed));
		core *= 0.5 + tissue;
		sheath *= smoothstep(0.2, 0.7, tissue + 0.2);
		hot = mix(hot, tint, 0.5);
	} else if (k == 11) {
		// Null lance: two pinched rails around a violet-white core.
		float pinch = 2.0 + 3.5 * sin(s * 3.14159);
		float d = (px - pinch) / 1.15;
		float rails = exp(-d*d) * (0.75 + 0.25 * fast);
		hot = mix(hot, tint, 0.45);
		core *= 0.8;
		sheath = sheath * 0.30 + rails * 1.35;
		motion = 1.0;
	}
	vec3 colour = hot * (core * 1.35 + fork_hot) + tint * (sheath * (0.55 + slow * 0.7) + fork_glow * 0.5);
	ALBEDO = clamp(colour * vCol.a * motion * env * ends * fx_gain, 0.0, 512.0);
}
"""

# Engine exhaust trails that follow a moving ship: a strip through the nozzle's recent positions (world space).
# VERTEX = centre point; NORMAL = the path's direction there; UV = (s along 0..1, side -0.5..0.5);
# CUSTOM0 = (colour, intensity); CUSTOM1 = (width0, width1, seed, style) with style 0 clean, 1 sooty sputter, 2 spore puffs,
# 3 guttering embers.
const TRAIL := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled, skip_vertex_transform;
""" + COMMON + """
uniform float trail_elapsed = 0.0;
uniform float trail_style = 0.0;
varying vec4 vCol;
varying vec4 vInfo;
void vertex() {
	vec3 wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
	vec3 wd = snorm((MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(NORMAL, 0.0)).xyz);
	float s = clamp(UV.x + trail_elapsed, 0.0, 1.0);
	float w = mix(CUSTOM1.x, CUSTOM1.y, s);
	vec3 side = snorm(cross(wd, CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD - wp));
	float seed = CUSTOM1.z;
	float du = frame_world(1.0, max(-(VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(wp, 1.0)).z, 0.01), PROJECTION_MATRIX, VIEWPORT_SIZE.y);
	w = max(w, du * 10.0);
	wp += side * UV.y * w;
	VERTEX = (VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(wp, 1.0)).xyz;
	vCol = CUSTOM0;
	vInfo = vec4(s, UV.y * 2.0, seed, trail_style);
}
void fragment() {
	float s = vInfo.x; float x = abs(vInfo.y); float seed = vInfo.z; int st = int(vInfo.w + 0.5);
	float n = fbm(vec2(s * 14.0 - scene_t * 0.6, vInfo.y * 1.2 + seed * 3.0));
	float n2 = fbm(vec2(s * 40.0 - scene_t * 0.5, vInfo.y * 2.0 + seed * 3.0));
	n = 0.5 * n + 0.5 * n2;
	float across = exp(-x * x * 2.2);
	float fade = spow(1.0 - s, 1.8);
	vec3 col = mix(vCol.rgb, vec3(0.30, 0.38, 0.60), smoothstep(0.0, 0.55, s));
	float m = smoothstep(0.25, 0.75, n + 0.15);
	if (st == 1) {
		col = mix(col, vec3(0.35, 0.25, 0.18), 0.5) * (0.5 + 0.5 * mix(cough(scene_t - s * 3.0, seed), 0.7, fx_calm));
	} else if (st == 2) {
		m *= 0.6 + 0.8 * smoothstep(0.55, 0.8, fbm(vec2(s * 22.0 - scene_t * 0.4, seed)));
	} else if (st == 3) {
		col *= 0.55 + 0.45 * vnoise(vec2(s * 9.0 - scene_t * 2.0, seed));
		col += vec3(1.0, 0.5, 0.15) * spow(vnoise(vec2(s * 60.0 - scene_t, seed * 3.0)), 12.0) * 2.0;
	}
	float root = smoothstep(0.0, 0.025, s);
	vec3 hot = mix(col, vec3(1.0, 0.94, 0.82), 0.6) * exp(-x*x*16.0) * 0.5;
	ALBEDO = clamp((col * across * m * 1.4 + hot) * root * fade * vCol.a * fx_gain, 0.0, 512.0);
}
"""

# Issue 1558 item 8: a kit torpedo/rocket trail. Same look as TRAIL, but the strip is one shared fixed mesh (point i
# in VERTEX.x, side in UV.y) and its samples come in the `pts` array (xyz world position, w birth time), so a moving
# round only uploads a small uniform each frame instead of building a new ArrayMesh. Samples past `count` collapse
# onto the last one with no width, so the unused end of the strip has no area.
static func kit_trail_code(points: int) -> String:
	var c: String = TRAIL.replace("uniform float trail_elapsed = 0.0;",
		"uniform vec4 pts[%d];\nuniform int count = 0;\nuniform float life = 0.38;\nuniform vec4 eng = vec4(1.0);\nuniform vec3 widths = vec3(0.1, 0.2, 0.0);" % points)
	c = c.replace("""	vec3 wp = (MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
	vec3 wd = snorm((MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(NORMAL, 0.0)).xyz);
	float s = clamp(UV.x + trail_elapsed, 0.0, 1.0);
	float w = mix(CUSTOM1.x, CUSTOM1.y, s);""", """	int n = max(count, 1);
	int i = int(VERTEX.x + 0.5);
	int k = min(i, n - 1);
	vec3 wp = pts[k].xyz;
	vec3 wd = snorm(pts[min(k + 1, n - 1)].xyz - pts[max(k - 1, 0)].xyz);
	float s = clamp((scene_t - pts[k].w) / max(life, 0.001), 0.0, 1.0);
	float w = i < n ? mix(widths.x, widths.y, s) : 0.0;""")
	c = c.replace("w = max(w, du * 10.0);", "w = i < n ? max(w, du * 10.0) : 0.0;")
	c = c.replace("float seed = CUSTOM1.z;", "float seed = widths.z;")
	c = c.replace("vCol = CUSTOM0;", "vCol = eng;")
	assert(c.contains("uniform vec4 pts[") and c.contains("vCol = eng;") and c.contains("float seed = widths.z;") and c.contains("i < n ? max(w"))
	return c


# Strike-craft history from squadron_wing's real stern samples. Kept here so
# attack runs and live wings use the same kit without changing their movement.
const CRAFT_TRAIL := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;
""" + COMMON + """
uniform sampler2D kit_flow : filter_linear, repeat_enable;
uniform float clock_now = 0.0;
uniform float newest_birth = 0.0;
uniform float trail_len = 1.0;
uniform float width_k = 0.026;
uniform float alpha_k = 0.56;
uniform float anchor_ready = 0.0;
uniform vec3 head_world = vec3(0.0);
varying vec2 vFromHead;
varying float vSide;
varying float vAge;
varying vec3 vTint;
void vertex() {
	float age = max(clock_now - UV2.x, 0.0);
	vec3 p = VERTEX + NORMAL * age * trail_len * 1.2;
	// The newest pair stays on the actual stern between 30 Hz samples.
	if (abs(UV2.x - newest_birth) < 0.0001) { p = head_world; }
	vec3 back = snorm(NORMAL);
	vec3 side = snorm(cross(back, CAMERA_POSITION_WORLD - p));
	float depth = max(-(VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(p, 1.0)).z, 0.01);
	float width = max(trail_len * width_k * (1.0 + age), max(px_world(10.0, depth, PROJECTION_MATRIX), frame_world(8.0, depth, PROJECTION_MATRIX, VIEWPORT_SIZE.y)));
	vec4 pc = PROJECTION_MATRIX * VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(p, 1.0);
	vec4 hc = PROJECTION_MATRIX * VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(head_world, 1.0);
	// issue 1211: in 1080-line pixels, so the 24 px tail and its flow keep their shape at 4K
	vFromHead = (pc.xy / max(pc.w, 0.0001) - hc.xy / max(hc.w, 0.0001)) * VIEWPORT_SIZE * 0.5 * (1080.0 / max(VIEWPORT_SIZE.y, 1.0));
	vSide = UV.y * 2.0 - 1.0;
	vAge = age;
	vTint = COLOR.rgb;
	POSITION = PROJECTION_MATRIX * VIEW_MATRIX * vec4(p + side * vSide * width * 0.5, 1.0);
}
void fragment() {
	float distance_px = length(vFromHead);
	if (anchor_ready < 0.5 || distance_px >= 24.0 || vAge >= 0.65) { discard; }
	float fade = spow(1.0 - distance_px / 24.0, 1.35) * (1.0 - vAge / 0.65);
	float flow = texture(kit_flow, vec2(fract(distance_px / 18.0 - clock_now * 1.4), vSide * 0.5 + 0.5)).g;
	float core = exp(-vSide * vSide * 16.0);
	float sheath = exp(-vSide * vSide * 2.4);
	vec3 hot = mix(vTint, vec3(1.0, 0.96, 0.86), 0.65);
	ALBEDO = (hot * core * 1.4 + vTint * sheath * (0.6 + flow)) * fade * alpha_k * 2.0 * fx_gain;
}
"""

# Debris chips: tumbling 3D shards lit by the scene lights, hot at first.
# a1 = (vel, life); a2 = (spin axis, spin rate); a3 = (size, period, tint, drag); a4 = (heat, seed, 0, 0)
const SHARD := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode cull_back, fog_disabled;
""" + COMMON + """
varying float vHeat;
varying float vSeed;
varying float vTint;
vec3 rotA(vec3 v, vec3 k, float an) { float c = cos(an); float s = sin(an); return v * c + cross(k, v) * s + k * dot(k, v) * (1.0 - c); }
void vertex() {
	vec4 a0 = CUSTOM0; vec4 a1 = CUSTOM1; vec4 a2 = CUSTOM2; vec4 a3 = CUSTOM3; vec4 a4 = vec4(UV, UV2);
	float a = scene_t - a0.w;
	float age = pAge(a, a3.y);
	float life = a1.w;
	vHeat = 0.0; vSeed = a4.y; vTint = a3.z;
	if (a < 0.0 || age >= life) {
		VERTEX = vec3(0.0, -50000.0, 0.0);
	} else {
		float t = age / life;
		float size = a3.x;
		if (a3.z >= 3.0) {
			// Hit plates must remain pieces at camera 170 after cooling, rather than disappearing into the stars.
			vec3 centre = a0.xyz + (a3.w > 0.0 ? a1.xyz * (1.0 - exp(-a3.w * age)) / a3.w : a1.xyz * age);
			float depth = -(VIEW_MATRIX * MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(centre, 1.0)).z;
			size = max(size, px_world(8.0, depth, PROJECTION_MATRIX));
		}
		float sc = size * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.85, 1.0, t));
		vec3 k = snorm(a2.xyz);
		float an = age * a2.w + a4.y * 6.2831853;
		float dr = a3.w;
		vec3 disp = dr > 0.0 ? a1.xyz * (1.0 - exp(-dr * age)) / dr : a1.xyz * age;
		VERTEX = a0.xyz + disp + rotA(VERTEX, k, an) * sc;
		NORMAL = rotA(NORMAL, k, an);
		vHeat = a4.x * exp(-age * (a3.z >= 3.0 ? 0.85 : 3.5));
	}
}
void fragment() {
	vec3 alb = vec3(0.032, 0.032, 0.036) * (0.6 + 0.9 * fract(vSeed * 17.3));
	if (vTint > 0.5) { alb = vec3(0.05, 0.06, 0.035) * (0.6 + 0.9 * fract(vSeed * 17.3)); }
	if (vTint >= 3.0) { alb = vec3(0.19, 0.16, 0.13) * (0.65 + 0.55 * fract(vSeed * 17.3)); }
	ALBEDO = alb;
	METALLIC = 0.5;
	ROUGHNESS = 0.45;
	EMISSION = vec3(1.0, 0.33, 0.06) * vHeat * 1.2 * fx_gain;
	if ((vTint > 1.5 && vTint < 2.5) || vTint > 3.5) {
		ALBEDO = vec3(0.3, 0.45, 0.6); METALLIC = 0.1; ROUGHNESS = 0.08;
		EMISSION = mix(vec3(0.2, 0.8, 1.0), vec3(0.9, 0.3, 1.0), abs(dot(NORMAL, VIEW))) * (0.08 + vHeat * 0.3) * fx_gain;
	}
}
"""

# Hull-hit fragments. The old SHARD material also serves other effects, so it has its own shader.
# a0 = (origin, born); a1 = (velocity, life); a2 = (tumble axis, spin); a3 = (size, phase, profile key, drag).
# a4 = (linear hull paint, fracture heat); the remaining texels carry the hit UV and finish.
# Negative profile keys mark the lead pieces.
const HIT_FRAGMENT := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode cull_back, fog_disabled;
""" + COMMON + """
uniform sampler2D fragment_meshes : filter_nearest, repeat_disable;
uniform sampler2D fragment_instances : filter_nearest, repeat_disable;
uniform int glass_profile;
// FINISH_SAMPLERS
varying vec4 part_pos; // template position and distance from cap centre toward the rim
varying flat vec4 surface_data; // surface class, glass, heat, visibility
varying flat vec3 paint;
varying flat vec4 finish_tint; // ship albedo multiplier and roughness
varying flat vec4 finish_orm; // metallic, specular, packed ORM present, source slot
varying flat float normal_scale;
varying vec2 paint_uv;
varying vec2 tear_uv;
vec3 turn_fragment(vec3 v, vec3 k, float c, float s) {
	return v * c + cross(k, v) * s + k * dot(k, v) * (1.0 - c);
}
vec4 particle_data(int column, int slot_index) {
	return texelFetch(fragment_instances, ivec2(column, slot_index), 0);
}
void vertex() {
	int slot_index = INSTANCE_ID;
	vec4 a0 = particle_data(1, slot_index);
	vec4 a1 = particle_data(2, slot_index);
	float age = scene_t - a0.w;
	if (age < 0.0 || age >= a1.w) {
		VERTEX = vec3(0.0, -50000.0, 0.0);
	} else {
		vec4 a2 = particle_data(3, slot_index);
		vec4 a3 = particle_data(4, slot_index);
		vec4 a4 = particle_data(0, slot_index);
		bool lead = a3.z < 0.0;
		int profile = int(lead ? -1.0 - a3.z : a3.z);
		int row = profile * 3;
		vec4 points = texelFetch(fragment_meshes, ivec2(VERTEX_ID, row), 0);
		vec4 normals = texelFetch(fragment_meshes, ivec2(VERTEX_ID, row + 1), 0);
		tear_uv = texelFetch(fragment_meshes, ivec2(VERTEX_ID, row + 2), 0).xy;
		vec3 centre = a0.xyz + pDisp(a1.xyz, a3.w, 0.0, age);
		float depth = -(VIEW_MATRIX * MODEL_MATRIX * vec4(centre, 1.0)).z;
		float pixel = frame_world(1.0, depth, PROJECTION_MATRIX, 1080.0);
		// Mid-sized pieces get a smaller boost. Flecks still follow their world size.
		float floor_px = lead ? 10.0 : 6.5 * smoothstep(0.21, 0.45, a3.x);
		float scale = max(a3.x, px_world(floor_px, depth, PROJECTION_MATRIX));
		float distance_fade = lead ? 1.0 : smoothstep(0.55, 1.45, scale / pixel);
		float t = age / a1.w;
		vec3 axis = snorm(a2.xyz);
		float angle = a3.y * 6.2831853 + age * a2.w;
		float c = cos(angle);
		float s = sin(angle);
		VERTEX = centre + turn_fragment(points.xyz, axis, c, s) * scale;
		NORMAL = turn_fragment(normals.xyz, axis, c, s);
		part_pos = points;
		paint = a4.rgb * mix(0.65, 1.05, a3.y);
		vec4 patch_u = particle_data(5, slot_index);
		vec4 patch_v = particle_data(6, slot_index);
		// Use the real size in the source patch even when the battle camera lifts the image size.
		vec2 offset = (points.xz + vec2(a3.y - 0.5, fract(a3.y * 7.0) - 0.5) * 0.55) * a3.x;
		paint_uv = patch_u.xy + patch_u.zw * offset.x + patch_v.xy * offset.y;
		finish_tint = particle_data(7, slot_index);
		finish_orm = vec4(particle_data(8, slot_index).xyz, patch_v.z);
		normal_scale = patch_v.w;
		float heat = a4.w * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.08, 1.05, age));
		surface_data = vec4(normals.w, float(profile >= glass_profile), heat, distance_fade * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.55, 1.0, t)));
	}
}

// Build the normal-map basis from the same UV gradients as the material. This also
// follows the smooth cap normals through folds and preserves the wall's hard normals.
vec3 mapped_normal(vec3 n, vec3 dx, vec3 dy, vec2 ux, vec2 uy, vec2 tilt) {
	vec3 t = cross(dy, n) * ux.x + cross(n, dx) * uy.x;
	vec3 b = cross(dy, n) * ux.y + cross(n, dx) * uy.y;
	float scale = max(dot(t, t), dot(b, b));
	return normalize(n + (t * tilt.x + b * tilt.y) * inversesqrt(max(scale, 1e-12)));
}

void fragment() {
	float fade = surface_data.w;
	vec2 dx = dFdx(paint_uv);
	vec2 dy = dFdy(paint_uv);
	vec2 tx = dFdx(tear_uv);
	vec2 ty = dFdy(tear_uv);
	vec3 px = dFdx(VERTEX);
	vec3 py = dFdy(VERTEX);
	float lip_width = min(0.12, fwidth(part_pos.w) * 0.35);
	if (fade < 1.0 && fade <= h21(floor(FRAGCOORD.xy))) {
		discard;
	}
	float wall = step(1.5, surface_data.x);
	float inside = step(0.5, surface_data.x) - wall;
	int slot = int(finish_orm.w);
	float heat = surface_data.z * mix(1.0, 0.45, fx_calm);
	float wear = vnoise(part_pos.xz * vec2(16.0, 29.0) + part_pos.y * 11.0);
	float scorch = smoothstep(0.78, 1.0, part_pos.w) * mix(0.25, 0.69, wear);
	float lip = smoothstep(mix(0.87, 0.96, wear) - lip_width, 1.0, part_pos.w);
	vec3 baked = paint * mix(0.64, 1.15, wear);
	vec3 orm = vec3(1.0);
	vec2 map_normal = vec2(0.0);
	// FINISH_SAMPLES
	if (slot >= 0) {
		baked *= finish_tint.rgb;
	}
	vec3 charred = baked * 0.11 + vec3(0.023, 0.018, 0.014);
	ALBEDO = mix(baked, charred, max(scorch, inside));
	METALLIC = mix(0.23, 0.63, wall);
	ROUGHNESS = mix(0.79 - 0.15 * wear, 0.38, wall);
	if (slot >= 0) {
		float packed = finish_orm.z;
		AO = mix(1.0, orm.r, packed * (1.0 - wall));
		METALLIC = mix(clamp(finish_orm.x * mix(1.0, orm.b, packed), 0.0, 1.0), 0.36, max(inside, wall));
		ROUGHNESS = clamp(finish_tint.a * mix(1.0, orm.g, packed) + 0.13 * scorch, 0.18, 0.96);
		SPECULAR = finish_orm.y;
	}
	if (wall > 0.5) {
		// Thin paint and a darker liner frame the bright torn alloy. Filter the
		// cross-section boundaries and directional scratch normals at pixel scale.
		float band_aa = max(0.022, (abs(tx.y) + abs(ty.y)) * 0.55);
		float skin = smoothstep(0.38 - band_aa, 0.38 + band_aa, tear_uv.y);
		float liner = 1.0 - smoothstep(-0.44 - band_aa, -0.44 + band_aa, tear_uv.y);
		vec2 grain = tear_uv * vec2(108.0, 4.0);
		float scratch = vnoise(grain);
		float grain_filter = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.28, 1.15, length(fwidth(grain)));
		vec3 alloy = vec3(0.29, 0.25, 0.21) * mix(0.58, 1.35, mix(0.5, scratch, grain_filter));

		samplers += "uniform sampler2D hull_orm_%d : hint_default_white, filter_linear_mipmap_anisotropic, repeat_enable;\n" % i
		samplers += "uniform sampler2D hull_normal_%d : hint_normal, filter_linear_mipmap_anisotropic, repeat_enable;\n" % i
		samples += """

		baked = textureGrad(hull_color_%d, paint_uv, dx, dy).rgb;
		orm = textureGrad(hull_orm_%d, paint_uv, dx, dy).rgb;

			vec2 fg = q / R * 5.5;
			vec2 fi = floor(fg);
			vec2 ff = fract(fg) - 0.5;

			vec2 jo = (vec2(h21(fi + seed + 3.7), h21(fi + seed + 8.1)) - 0.5) * 0.45;

			float pit = step(0.22, cellv) * step(cellv, 0.88) * spot;
			float chip = step(0.88, cellv) * spot;

			hr = mix(0.85, 0.3, exp(-age / 9.0) * pit);

			float acen = (sector + 0.5) / 7.0 * TAU - PI + (h21(vec2(sector, seed)) - 0.5) * 0.5;

			float tb = clamp(hd / max(H * 0.45, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0);

		vec3 sc = vec3(1.0, 0.4, 0.1);

		float sk = 1.0;

		else if (style == 3) { sc = vec3(0.35, 0.65, 1.0); scl = 6.0; }
		else if (style == 8) { sc = vec3(0.62, 0.95, 0.14); scl = 8.0; sk = 1.3; }
		else if (style == 9) { sc = vec3(0.45, 0.65, 1.0); scl = 6.0; sk = 1.3; }
		else if (style == 7) { sk = 1.0; scl = 6.0; }
		else if (style == 6 || style == 11) { scl = 9.0; sk = 1.2; }
		else if (style == 10) { sc = vec3(1.0, 0.55, 0.25); scl = 5.0; sk = 1.1; }

			hem += vec3(1.0, 0.32, 0.06) * smoothstep(0.62, 0.8, hn) * (1.0 - smoothstep(0.15, 0.5, hu)) * (0.08 + 0.5 * live) * exp(-age / 40.0);

		float at = a + ha * (1.0 - a);

		em += hem * ha * (1.0 - a);
		a = at;
		// r12 (Opus): a dim broken edge that lasts the battle (about five minutes to half), so a cooled plasma, shell,

		float le = 0.0;
		vec2 eb = vec2(0.25, 0.45);
		if (style == 2) { le = 0.32; }
		else if (style == 3) { le = 0.36; }
		else if (style == 4 || style == 5) { le = 0.3; }
		else if (style == 7) { le = 0.5; eb = vec2(0.55, 0.8); }

		float lc = (style == 2 || style == 3 || style == 4 || style == 5 || style == 7) ? 0.7 : ((style == 8 || style == 9) ? 0.4 : 0.0);
		if (lc > 0.0) {
			float core = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.04, 0.22, hu)) * (0.5 + 0.5 * smoothstep(0.35, 0.65, hn));

			float edge = smoothstep(eb.x, eb.x + ew, hu) * (1.0 - smoothstep(eb.y - ew, eb.y, hu));

		vec2 dd = vec2(dot(vE.xyz, t1), dot(vE.xyz, t2));
		float along = clamp(dot(q, dd), -vE.w, vE.w);
		float trench = length(q - dd * along) / R;
		alb = vec3(0.008, 0.006, 0.009);
		a = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.7, 1.5, trench);

		a = (1.0 - smoothstep(0.88, 1.0, u)) * (wound_kind == 1 ? smoothstep(0.0, 3.0, age) : 0.7);
		em = glow * ridge * 0.035;
		if (wound_kind == 3) {
			float panel = floor((q.x / R + 1.0) * 2.0);

	}
	ALBEDO = alb;
	ALPHA = clamp(a, 0.0, 1.0);
	ROUGHNESS = rough;

	METALLIC = mix(0.35, 0.0, hs);
	SPECULAR = mix(0.5, 0.1, hs);
	EMISSION = em * fx_gain;

"""

# Issue 462, the tell: a tear along one or two break lines (a capital has two), drawn as an overlay on the dying hull. It
# grows across the hull from the hit side (grow, half_span: -1 at the hit side, +1 across), white-hot at its moving tip
# and ember behind, at least two pixels wide at any camera. straight = 1 for a lance cut (the beam's own line).
# R398 (issue 1394, Ryan Nov 21: "The whole hull shouldn't glow green either. Just specific affected areas"): an acid
# kill's tell. Up to six spots in the ship's frame (xyz, radius), each a sick green patch with a ragged, eaten edge that
# spreads from a third of its radius to all of it between rise.x and rise.y (scene_t). No line, no white.
const MELT_GLOW := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_back, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;
""" + COMMON + """
uniform mat4 frame;
uniform vec4 spots[6];
uniform int n_spots = 0;
uniform vec2 rise = vec2(0.0, 1.0);
uniform vec3 hot = vec3(0.62, 0.85, 0.18);
uniform vec3 deep = vec3(0.26, 0.40, 0.05);
varying vec3 hp;
void vertex() {
	hp = (frame * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
}
void fragment() {
	float u = clamp((scene_t - rise.x) / max(rise.y - rise.x, 0.0001), 0.0, 1.0);
	float g = 0.0;
	for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
		if (i >= n_spots) { break; }
		float rad = max(spots[i].w, 0.001);
		float r = rad * (0.35 + 0.65 * u);
		vec3 q = (hp - spots[i].xyz) / rad;
		float eaten = (vnoise(q.xy * 3.1 + q.z * 1.7 + float(i) * 4.3) - 0.5) * 0.55;
		float d = distance(hp, spots[i].xyz) / r + eaten;
		g = max(g, 1.0 - smoothstep(0.35, 1.0, d));
	}
	float pulse = 0.88 + 0.12 * sin(scene_t * 4.5 + hp.x * 0.7);
	ALBEDO = clamp(mix(deep, hot, g * g) * g * u * pulse * 1.5 * fx_gain, 0.0, 8.0);
}
"""


const TEAR := """
shader_type spatial;
render_mode unshaded, blend_add, depth_draw_never, cull_disabled, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;
""" + COMMON + """
uniform mat4 frame;
uniform vec2 open_a = vec2(0.3, 1.33);
uniform vec3 cut_at = vec3(0.0);
uniform vec3 cut_axis = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
uniform vec2 open_b = vec2(-1.0, 1.0);
uniform vec3 cut_at_b = vec3(0.0);
uniform vec3 cut_axis_b = vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0);
uniform vec3 grow = vec3(0.0, 0.0, -1.0);
uniform float half_span = 1.0;
uniform float width = 0.1;
uniform float straight = 0.0;
uniform vec3 tip = vec3(1.0, 0.94, 0.82);
uniform vec3 ember = vec3(1.0, 0.36, 0.07);
varying vec3 cut_p;
varying float view_d;
void vertex() {
	cut_p = (frame * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).xyz;
	view_d = -(MODELVIEW_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0)).z;
}
vec3 tear_line(vec3 at, vec3 axis, vec2 open, float pxw) {
	float u = (scene_t - open.x) / max(open.y - open.x, 0.0001);
	if (u <= 0.0) { return vec3(0.0); }
	float w = max(width, pxw * 3.2);
	float wig = (1.0 - straight) * (sin(dot(cut_p, vec3(1.7, 8.3, 5.1))) * 0.6 + sin(dot(cut_p, vec3(5.3, 2.9, 11.7))) * 0.4);
	float d = abs(dot(cut_p - at, axis) + wig * w * 0.9);
	float s = dot(cut_p - at, grow) / max(half_span, 0.001);
	float front = mix(-1.15, 1.15, clamp(u, 0.0, 1.0));
	float behind = front - s;
	if (behind < 0.0) { return vec3(0.0); }
	float core = 1.0 - smoothstep(w * 0.3, w, d);
	float halo = 1.0 - smoothstep(w, w * 4.0, d);
	float hot = exp(-behind * behind / 0.04) * (1.0 - smoothstep(1.0, 1.25, u));
	float age = clamp(behind / 2.3, 0.0, 1.0);
	vec3 c = mix(ember * 1.4, ember * vec3(0.7, 0.45, 0.35), age);
	c = mix(c, tip * 2.4, hot);
	return c * (core * 3.6 + halo * 0.9) * smoothstep(0.0, 0.06, u);
}
void fragment() {
	float pxw = px_world(1.0, view_d, PROJECTION_MATRIX);
	vec3 col = tear_line(cut_at, cut_axis, open_a, pxw);
	if (open_b.x >= 0.0) { col += tear_line(cut_at_b, cut_axis_b, open_b, pxw); }
	if (dot(col, col) < 1e-6) { discard; }
	ALBEDO = clamp(col * fx_gain, 0.0, 8.0);
}
"""

# Issue 1077: a ragged, stepped offset along a cut's axis, so a tear line wanders across the plates: value noise over the
# cut plane in plate-sized cells, eased so each plate holds a level and the line steps between them, plus a finer octave.
# fx_jag.x is the reach (ship units), fx_jag.y the plate size; zero reach is a straight line.
const JAG_FN := """
uniform vec2 fx_jag = vec2(0.0, 1.0);
float fxj_hash(vec3 p) { p = fract(p * 0.1031); p += dot(p, p.zyx + 31.32); return fract((p.x + p.y) * p.z); }
float fxj_vn(vec3 x) {
	vec3 i = floor(x);
	vec3 f = smoothstep(0.3, 0.7, fract(x));
	return mix(mix(mix(fxj_hash(i), fxj_hash(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 0.0)), f.x), mix(fxj_hash(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0)), fxj_hash(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 0.0)), f.x), f.y),
		mix(mix(fxj_hash(i + vec3(0.0, 0.0, 1.0)), fxj_hash(i + vec3(1.0, 0.0, 1.0)), f.x), mix(fxj_hash(i + vec3(0.0, 1.0, 1.0)), fxj_hash(i + vec3(1.0, 1.0, 1.0)), f.x), f.y), f.z);
}
float fx_jag_offset(vec3 p, vec3 axis) {
	if (fx_jag.x <= 0.0) { return 0.0; }
	vec3 q = (p - axis * dot(p, axis)) / max(fx_jag.y, 1e-4);
	float v = 0.7 * fxj_vn(q) + 0.3 * fxj_vn(q * 2.7 + 5.3);
	return (v - 0.5) * 2.0 * fx_jag.x;
}
"""

# Issue 1077 (prototype, off by default: rendering/effects/death_story): structural strain before a big hull splits. The
# plating along each break line bulges a little and ripples (outward only, so it never sinks into the authored decks),
# and the dying hull's power-down material and the tear overlay move it the same way. Ship-space points and normals.
const STRAIN_FN := """
uniform vec4 fx_strain_at[3];
uniform vec4 fx_strain_n[3];
uniform vec3 fx_strain_k = vec3(0.0, 1.0, 0.0);
uniform vec2 fx_strain_t = vec2(1e9, 1e9);
float fx_strain_amount(float t) { return smoothstep(fx_strain_t.x, fx_strain_t.y, t); }
float fx_strain_band(int i, vec3 p) {
	if (fx_strain_at[i].w <= 0.0) { return 0.0; }
	float d = dot(p - fx_strain_at[i].xyz, fx_strain_n[i].xyz);
	float e = 1.0 - smoothstep(0.0, max(fx_strain_n[i].w, 0.0001), abs(d));
	return e * e;
}
vec3 fx_strain_offset(vec3 p, vec3 n, float t) {
	float a = fx_strain_amount(t) * fx_strain_k.x;
